entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know you warned us about some[n]freaky thing showin' up in Mementos,[n]but what exactly IS it?
entries.uk: Знаю, ти попереджав про якусь[n]моторошну штуку в Мементосі,[n]але що воно взагалі ТАКЕ?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even I have no idea—all I know is that[n]it's terrifying.
entries.uk: Навіть я гадки не маю. Знаю лише,[n]що воно жахливе.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...As you can clearly see.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Isn't this thing scary? ...It's not gonna[n]start moving, is it?
entries.uk: Страшна ж штука, скажи? ...Вона ж[n]не почне рухатися, правда?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Eep! What, what!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Nothing—I just realized I'm hungry.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: THAT'S what this thing made you[n]realize!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I thought I'd acclimate to Mementos[n]at some point, but... this thing always[n]kept me on edge.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh, I am right there with you. I always[n]freaked out whenever I picked up its[n]signal.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Like, maximum-level heebie-jeebies.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I hope we never see it again, if we can[n]help it.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Is something wrong, Haru-senpai?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, ah...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was just thinking how this rather looks[n]like the good-weather charm we used[n]to make in elementary school.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Ohhh, I... suppose so? I think if I hung[n]one that looked like this outside my[n]window, I wouldn't get any peace...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, this is the Shadow that stalks[n]Mementos...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Is it the root of all human fear? A core[n]desire of the id? A warning from the[n]superego of Mementos?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I suppose it could be any number of[n]things—but in the end, this is all mere[n]speculation.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh... Yeah... Speculatin' 'bout Ed's[n]desire for the Supery-go... I agree.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, your idiocy's showing.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: When I behold this, the expression[n]"end of my rope" comes to mind.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: If I had to put it in shogi terms, I'd say[n]it's like being caught unaware in[n]checkmate.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Even still, the Phantom Thieves wouldn't[n]lose to that.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: You believe in them an awful lot,[n]don't you?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Yeah, I guess...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Those guys can do anything, no matter[n]how scary. That's what I think, anyway.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: *giggle* I wholly agree.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Look at this thing... If I were still a kid,[n]I'd probably start bawlin' my eyes out[n]if I even caught a glimpse of it.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Oh, yeah? So you were the crybaby type,[n]mister?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well no, not exactly— Wait, are you[n]saying you're not scared of this thing?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Nah. I see bad guys like this all the time[n]in video games.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Kids these days are so desensitized...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Eeeek!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: If I ever ran into this thing at night, I bet[n]I'd keel over three times in a row...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Despair, fear, insanity—I'm sensing[n]so many negative emotions from it.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Don't tell me! I can't handle this kind[n]of stuff at all!

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Those guns have such strange barrels...

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Do they even work? Where'd he get[n]those things customized?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So you're curious about this entity[n]as well? I haven't been able to tear[n]myself away from it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I sense something in it urging me[n]forward... Something other than[n]dread, that is.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: *chuckle* I only grow more mesmerized[n]as I continue to view it.

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: ...The hell is your deal, bud?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hey. Check out this bizarre-looking[n]thing.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Quite—but what is even more bizarre[n]is the prisoner's ability to defeat such a[n]monstrosity.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Could this be the result of his[n]rehabilitation efforts?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hmph! If so, then the prisoner should[n]be crying tears of gratitude for our[n]efforts!
